title: Cloud Storage & Media
subtitle: Cloudflare R2 Storage, Media CDN & Catalog Backups
description: Direct cloud storage of media files and catalog backups in Cloudflare R2
mediaStorageIntroTitle: How Cloudflare R2 Media Storage Works
mediaStorageIntroDesc: Product photos from imported feeds are initially stored via supplier URL or cached locally. Uploading to Cloudflare R2 protects your catalog from missing images and serves them from high-speed CDN without egress fees.
allSyncedTitle: All catalog photos are saved in Cloudflare R2
needSyncDesc: Supplier photos don't count toward your cloud quota, but may disappear if the supplier updates their website. Upload them to R2 to protect your catalog.
allSyncedDesc: Your products are fully protected and delivered via your personal high-speed CDN.
searchFilesPlaceholder: Search by filename or S3 key...
noFilesFound: No uploaded files in Cloudflare R2 yet
noFilesDesc: You can upload photos in the «Photos & Media» tab or add a new photo directly in the product drawer.
backupCatalogDesc: Saves the complete state of your catalog: products, categories, pricing markups, and suppliers. In case of an import error or issue, you can restore your catalog in 1 click.
readyToBackup: Products and categories ready to backup
backupCreatedSuccess: Catalog backup created and saved to cloud successfully
restoreConfirmDesc: This will update products, categories, and markup rules with data from the selected backup.
emptyBackupsList: No saved catalog backups in cloud yet
emptyBackupsListDesc: Click «Create Cloud Backup Now» to protect your catalog against data loss.
autoSyncOnImport: Automatic photo upload on feed import
autoSyncOnImportDesc: Automatically upload new images from imported feeds to Cloudflare R2
webpCompressionDesc: Convert heavy JPEG and PNG files to modern lightweight WebP before uploading
clearLocalCacheDesc: Removes temporary downloaded files from disk while preserving database and cloud copies
cleanupOrphansDesc: Scans Cloudflare R2 storage for files not linked to catalog products (old duplicates or incomplete uploads) and safely deletes them to reclaim disk quota.
noOrphansFound: No orphaned garbage found in storage, all files are synced!
cleanupStartedInBackground: Cloudflare R2 orphan cleanup started in background
